decision.explanation: The documents present conflicting claims about the naming origin of Lupáčova. One attributes it to Martin Lupáč, a Czech religious writer, citing historical records and official statements from 1885. Another attributes it to the Höchst family, a German textile-industry dynasty, citing alternative historical research and earlier archival references (1785).
